title: Total degree of a squarefree monomial
statement: Fix a field $K$ and let $s \subseteq \{0,1,\dots,n-1\}$ be a set of variable indices. The total degree of the squarefree monomial $\prod_{i \in s} X_i$ in the polynomial ring $K[X_0,\dots,X_{n-1}]$ is at most $\abs{s}$.
hypotheses_covered: s is a finite set of indices in Fin n
the monomial is the squarefree product over s
replaced: The total degree of $\prod_{i \in s} X_i$ is at most $\abs{s}$.
